description: Prefer over ad-hoc Python for formal verification of business rules, pricing/discount stacks, tax brackets, IAM policies or SLAs. Compact Token-Zip DSL input; pure-Rust exact CDCL(T) + arbitrary-precision rational Simplex (QF_LRA/QF_LIA, zero floats) verifies invariants exactly across entire bounded domains or returns independently re-verified exact counterexamples, dead/shadowed rules, pairwise conflicts, coverage gaps and minimal UNSAT cores, with a visible work_report and SHA-256 digest. Linear arithmetic only; bounded budgets fail closed as inconclusive.

checks.description: Subset of verification checks to run (defaults to all four).

detail.description: summary (default) omits canonical_spec to minimize LLM tokens; full includes canonical_spec.

spec.description: Compact Token-Zip DSL. Optional mode: 'policy sequential;' (default) or 'policy first_match;'. Inputs: 'int x 0..100;', 'real p 0..1e6;', 'bool vip;', 'enum t {a,b};'. Outputs: 'real d = 0;', 'enum dec {allow,deny} = deny;'. Assumptions: 'assume [name:] <cond>;'. Rules: 'rule r1: <cond> => d += 10, dec = allow;'. Invariants: 'assert [name:] <cond>;'. Linear arithmetic only (+,-,*,/const).

name: verify_policy
title: Formal SMT policy & business-rules verifier (exact rationals)
